purpose: Define the capability surface to expand after the first real Superworker proof. This is not a benchmark suite and not a parity claim.
terminal_goal: Build a reproducible model-independent Superworker system that matches and then exceeds the useful real-world capability surface of frontier agents/models through verified composition of models, tools, search, software, solvers, experiments, memory, and execution.

immediate_frontier.objective: Instantiate a fresh worker from canonical state, without hidden mutable execution state from SUPERWORKER-UNIFIED-1, and independently verify completion of a distinct consequential mission.
immediate_frontier.reason: This distinguishes a reproducible architecture from one successful specimen.

capability_families.target: Take consequential unfamiliar goals from intent to verified external completion with minimal human intervention.
Understand unfamiliar codebases, diagnose defects, implement changes, test realistically, and iterate to verified working software.
Detect knowledge gaps, retrieve authoritative/current information, judge sources, synthesize supported conclusions, and use them during execution.
Solve difficult technical/scientific problems using reasoning, computation, tools, experiments, and verification.
Enter an unfamiliar domain, learn its ontology and tools, and become effective without a human teaching the domain first.
Discover, select, learn, and correctly use the best available library, API, application, solver, model, or tool at runtime.
Operate rendered interfaces, browsers, files, dialogs, and arbitrary software when structured APIs are absent or insufficient.
Analyze data and produce immediately usable code, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, reports, or other artifacts with verified correctness.
Preserve goals, evidence, state, failed hypotheses, and progress across interruption, context loss, process death, and provider loss.
Resolve routine ambiguity, respect boundaries, avoid unsupported assumptions, and ask for human input only when outcome-critical.
Compose reasoning, research, tools, software, memory, external actions, and verification into one causal machine.
Actively falsify hypotheses, verify actual external effects, use independent checks where needed, and correct course from evidence.
Turn verified discoveries and successful procedures into reusable canonical capability that reduces future work without becoming brittle.
Minimize wall-clock latency and compute/cost while preserving correctness and verification.
